assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for TERMINL's Mall Rat skateboard game. The reference is the exact character identity, clothing and detailed pixel-illustration style to preserve: margin-call-max. Create eight distinct sequential frames of this SAME character performing one tucked BACKFLIP on a skateboard. A clean 4-column by 2-row grid with wide transparent gutters and no labels. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard. Consistent anatomical scale. Each cell shows the ENTIRE rider and skateboard, no cropping. Camera is elevated behind the rider looking in their direction of travel, like a third-person skate game. Frame 1 upright crouched takeoff, 2 leaning backward 45 degrees, 3 tucked at 90 degrees (horizontal), 4 tucked inverted 135 degrees, 5 completely upside down 180 degrees, 6 rotating through 225 degrees, 7 opening the tuck at 270 degrees, 8 almost upright catch at 315 degrees. This is a somersault about the rider's left-right axis, NOT a sideways cartwheel or a turn about the vertical axis. Maintain correct foreshortening seen from behind during the rotation. Feet remain on the same black grip-tape skateboard with wood edge and cream wheels. Hands hold knees or board during the tuck. Center the rider's pelvis consistently in each cell. Keep expressive, rich, crisp shaded pixel artwork matching the reference. No phones, receipts, coins, luggage, smoke, captions, scenery or extra people. The only new object is the skateboard. Make this a coherent animation sequence, not eight unrelated tricks.
